t_advice_summary_textbox.text: This is lengthy!The gnomes' size, hat type and position are irrelevant. Ignore them and focus entirely on the colour of the gnomes.They always appear in the same pairs (sometimes different positions, but always the same colour pairs). Orange & Brown, Green & Pink, Red & Yellow, Blue & Purple.Orange, Green Red and Blue = Bright Forest & Bright BasketBrown, Pink, Yellow and Purple = Dark Forest & Dark BasketAfter a few rounds, you'll realise one forest has more mushrooms than the other. Use this information to end up in the forest with the most mushrooms. Over the course of the game, if you notice your mushrooms start to decrease try the other forest for a bit!Your goal is to get as many mushrooms as possible.Try to consistently reach the forest that has the most mushrooms in it, regardless of your multiplier.Good luck!

vb_textbox.text: Your mission is to collect the most mushrooms.The arms, positions, type of hat etc are all irrelevant - just focus on the colour.They always appear in the same pair:Red & YellowGreen & PinkBlue & PurpleBrown & OrangeSome gnomes take you to the light forest with a light basket (red, orange, blue, green)Some gnomes take you to the dark forest with a dark basket (brown, pink, purple and yellow)Once you find a large amount of mushrooms, keep going to that forest a few more times (until that reduces and then swap it up until you find a large bunch again!)Consistently arrive at the forest with the most amount of mushrooms, and you'll do just fine. If you get a zero, make sure you switch it up next time.You don't get a lot of time to think but, my advice, is to pick one of the forests and repeat those four colours. You get to grips with which ones take you to which forest about half way through.Good luck, you've got this!
